headline: S&P 500 Prints Fresh Record As Chips Rip And Hormuz Talks Crack The Oil Trade
summary: The S&P 500 printed a fresh record above 7,700 on Tuesday as an incoming ban on China-made datacenter components lit the optical and memory names on fire, Palantir gapped up 29% on its overnight "alien" quarter, and a sharp Hormuz-driven crude selloff took some heat out of the inflation picture. AMD and SpaceX then delivered a very different tape after the bell. Here is what actually mattered.

headline: Is Kimberly Clark (KMB) Undervalued After Q2 Earnings And A Lowered 2026 Outlook?
summary: Kimberly-Clark (KMB) is back in focus after second quarter 2026 earnings beat profit expectations but fell short on revenue, as management flagged ongoing profit pressure from false diaper quality allegations in China and lowered its full year outlook. See our latest analysis for Kimberly-Clark. Kimberly-Clark’s share price has gained 12.48% over the past 90 days and 10.03% year to date. However, the 1-year total shareholder return declined 12.80%, suggesting recent momentum is rebuilding...

headline: How Investors Are Reacting To Kimberly-Clark (KMB) Mixed Q2 Results And New Hesperaloe Fiber Bet
summary: Kimberly-Clark reported past second-quarter 2026 results showing sales of US$4,189 million versus US$4,163 million a year earlier, while net income fell to US$345 million from US$509 million, and also unveiled an alternative natural fiber program using the drought-resistant hesperaloe plant to support future sustainable hygiene products. An interesting angle is how Kimberly-Clark is pairing only modest sales growth and weaker quarterly earnings with a patented hesperaloe-based materials...
